enterNameOrEmail: Enter a name or email to update
interfaceDescription: Personalize how Romeo looks and behaves for you.
languageDescription: Changes supported navigation and chat labels immediately.
memoryDescription: Review exactly what Romeo may retain and send as context.
memoryLibraryDescription: Only enabled, unexpired memories are added to model context. Every item remains visible and reversible.
noteLibraryDescription: Keep personal or workspace Markdown notes ready to reuse in chat.
notesDescription: Create reusable personal and workspace notes.
notificationsDescription: Choose what you're notified about and where.
preferencesSyncFailed: Preferences were applied locally but could not be synced.
profileDescription: Your identity and role within this organization.
profileEditDescription: Update your display name or email.
chatPreferencesDescription: Control optional chrome in the conversation surface. Errors, stop, and permissions stay available either way.
chatPrefFollowUpsDesc: Show next-message chips under the last model reply.
chatPrefStarterPromptsDesc: Show organization starter cards on an empty chat.
chatPrefContinueDesc: Show a Continue button after the last model reply.
chatPrefEnterToSendDesc: Press Enter to send. Shift+Enter inserts a newline. When off, use Ctrl/Cmd+Enter to send.
chatPrefStickToBottomDesc: Keep the transcript scrolled to the latest tokens when you are near the bottom.
chatPrefRunStatusDesc: Show waiting, tool, and retry status above a streaming answer.
chatPrefModelLabelDesc: Show which base model produced each reply.
chatPrefTimestampsDesc: Show when each model message was created.
securityDescription: Review the devices signed in to your account.
themeDescription: System follows your device’s light or dark setting.
